The '''Guild Hall''' was the government and economic center of the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Vossport/Legends|Vossport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weik/Legends|Weik]].

==Overview==
A large block building constructed in a hill overlooking the docks of Vossport, the Guild Hall was allegedly constructed using magic. While the members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] that first landed on Weik had long been forgotten, the legend could indicate the Order's members had a hand in the construction of the guild hall. The ceiling of the central hall was made of [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] that was considered an architectural model. Within the Guild Hall, the members of the city's most powerful commerce guilds met to govern the city and negotiate the movement of [[wind-ship]]s across the [[Rimesea/Legends|Rimesea]] and ensure the stability of trade routes between Vossport and far-off ports such as [[Fume/Legends|Fume]].<ref name="NoP" />
